Simple table populates the tables array in result

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "html_to_markdown"
result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert('<table><thead><tr><th>Name</th><th>Age</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td>Alice</td><td>30</td></tr></tbody></table>', HtmlToMarkdown::ConversionOptions.new(include_document_structure: true))
puts result.content.inspect
puts result.tables.inspect
```
